name: Kunoichi Inpou de Gokuraku Shouten♪ ~Tokihanatareta Eroero Ninjutsu!?~
original_name: くノ一淫法で極楽昇天♪ ～解き放たれたエロエロ忍術!?～
source:
Karasu was a lawless ninja on the run.
Hyoka and Monika are ninjettes who want to save the village he ruined.
The two girls face up to a taboo-breaking ninja and his men corrupted by the dark arts!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121854.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
卡尔土是一个无法无天的逃亡忍者。
冰花和莫妮卡是忍者，想要拯救被他毁掉的村庄。
两个女孩要面对一位违反禁忌的忍者和他的手下，他们被黑魔法腐蚀了！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121854.html]DLsite English[/url]]
